newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Seven killed in Ethiopian air force plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed in Ethiopian air force plane crash.

text.p: Seven people were killed and several others injured when an Ethiopian air force plane crashed near a market on Wednesday, the state-run Ethiopian News Agency (ENA) reported.

Witnesses and ENA said the plane, on a training flight, crashed at Mojo some 70 km (40 miles) south of Addis Ababa and people on the ground and in the plane may have perished in the fire that engulfed the market area.
It was not known whether there were any plane survivors but the agency suggested most of the dead were those at the market.
ENA's correspondent in Mojo reported that it was possible the casualty figure could rise as there could be people still buried under the burning plane.
ENA said market stalls and several shops were completely gutted by fire from the plane that crashed.
There was no statement from the military on the crash.
ENA said panic-stricken residents of Mojo rushed to the scene to search for family members that may have been in the area during the accident.
